title_xi: New Database: defaultValue of named parameter in SQL template should default to null
description_xi: The defaultValue of a named parameter in SQL template should default to null.    The user should not need to specify it in xml or Studio.

title_xi: Logging infrastructure should not keep a reference to any classloaders
description_xi: No logging context should keep a reference to any classloader object. Otherwise, that classloader will fail to be collected if the logger is held on a static field
